title: Documentation Refresh — Validate and Update
description: Identify documentation drift, validate code examples, and check documentation completeness.
goals: Check documentation covers all public functions

tasks.title: List all public functions
command: import inspect, sample_app; funcs=[name for name,obj in inspect.getmembers(sample_app) if inspect.isfunction(obj) and not name.startswith('_')]; print('\n'.join(sorted(funcs)))

tasks.title: Check README documents all functions
command: readme=open('README.md').read(); funcs=['add','multiply','divide','fibonacci','is_prime']; missing=[f for f in funcs if f not in readme]; print(f'Missing from README: {missing}' if missing else 'All functions documented in README')

tasks.title: Validate README code examples
command: from sample_app import add, multiply; assert add(1,2)==3; assert multiply(3,4)==12; print('README examples validated successfully')

tasks.title: Check API reference completeness
command: docs=open('docs/api.md').read(); funcs=['add','multiply','divide','fibonacci','is_prime']; missing=[f for f in funcs if f not in docs]; print(f'Missing from API docs: {missing}' if missing else 'API docs complete')
